messages:
elaine_sdr: Heads-up — Acme Health wants a 6-week POC + 6mo pilot on Dedicated with SOC2 + VPC. They asked if we can do 40% off list for the pilot to match competitor pricing.

jordan_ae: Who's the sponsor? ARR motion after pilot?

elaine_sdr: Sponsor is VP Product (healthcare). If pilot succeeds they plan to convert to 2yr committed Dedicated (est. $180k/year). Pilot expected spend = ~$45k for 6mo at list.

sreya_cs: 6-week POC + onboarding will need ~60 engineer-hours (SE + infra). That adds about $12k cost to deliver. Also SOC2 + VPC onboarding is non-trivial.

deal-desk: 40% is outside standard approval matrix. Please provide net revenue math and margin after SE costs. Also attach the customer email thread and security questionnaire summary.

elaine_sdr: Copying numbers below:

```
List pilot price (6mo): $45,000
Proposed 40% off -> $27,000
SE/onboarding cost (est): $12,000
Net to Redwood = $15,000
If convert to 2yr commit after pilot -> ARR ~$180,000
```

jordan_ae: OK. With those numbers net margin on pilot is pretty low. If we push to 30% off instead: pilot $31,500, net ~$19,500. Better but still thin. Can we get a signed MSA + 2yr convert commitment clause in the pilot contract?

deal-desk: Rules from pricing guide (finance_bot): max pre-signed discount without exec is 25%. Above 25% requires VP Rev signoff. Link: <https://rdw.internal/deals/discount-policy>.

finance_bot: Automated check: requested 40% > policy threshold. Recommend escalation to VP Rev for >30% or CFO for >35%.

elaine_sdr: Customer insists competitor matched 40% for the pilot but no long-term upfront commitment. I can push for a conversion commitment clause: "If pilot results met, customer will commit to 2yr within 30 days of pilot completion or pay difference." Would that be acceptable?

deal-desk: That clause helps. To approve 30% we need: 1) signed pilot SOW with conversion clause, 2) PO or purchase intent email, 3) SE hours cost acknowledged, 4) legal to sign off on data residency addendum. With those, we can approve up to 30% discount temporarily. Anything >30% needs VP Rev.

legal_ops: Flag: VPC + SOC2 means addendum for data processing and residency. Also include termination for non-conversion and responsibility for egress costs in SOW. I can draft quick addendum template.

elaine_sdr: I have PO-intent email from VP Product. I'll get the SOW signed and ask for the conversion clause. Can we get preliminary 30% approval so I can give the customer a yes today?

deal-desk: Provisional: approved 30% off pilot contingent on the items above being present in the SOW and legal addendum signed. Final approval pending VP Rev if they push for >30%.

jordan_ae: I'll book SE hours with viktor (cc se_viktor) and mark them as billable to pilot. Also will push customer for signature of conversion commitment.

se_viktor: Acknowledged — I can cover SE time next week, will log hours to the pilot line.

elaine_sdr: Great — I'll draft SOW with conversion clause and route to legal. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

deal-desk: Please attach final SOW & PO to the deal in the CRM and tag @deal-desk for final audit.

legal_ops: I'll review the SOW once it's in my inbox. Expect a short turnaround if no unusual terms.

elaine_sdr: Will do. Closing loop here.
